title: Record the writes that leave register 39 at -2
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 23304, register 39 holds `-2` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- Event 23237 copies register 18 at `-4`. Event 23278 adds `-1/2` times register 343 at `-4` and leaves `-2`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The writes that produce register 18 are not traced.
